Safe placement involves specific sleep-position, surface and bedding precautions. A vague safe-place phrase is insufficient as standalone guidance; no combined safe-pause passage is approved by this audit.

interpretation_limits: Application statements such as not diagnosing through chat or not treating a short answer as complete instructions are editorial safety boundaries, not direct publisher quotations.
Passage age bands are project eligibility restrictions, not proof that each publisher explicitly validates every age in that band.
A reachable official page and an unexpired review date do not establish clinical correctness or Kenya applicability.
No clinical reviewer approval, retrieval metrics, answer-quality scores or live activation is recorded by this source check.
